name: footer-folding-columns
title: Folding columns footer
description: A footer for large sites: up to six link columns that fold into tap-to-open groups on a phone, with a bar for social and legal.
docs: Give up to six columns, each with a title and groups of links; a group may have a heading of its own. From md up everything is visible. Below md each column is a button with aria-expanded and a plus or a minus, and defaultOpen lists the titles that start open. The desktop heading and the phone button are separate elements, and the links are in the page either way, closed or not. Columns animate their height and snap open under reduced motion. aside is a slot beside the brand (a newsletter, a status link), social takes icon or text profiles, and legal with legalLinks fills the bottom bar. Pass linkAs={Link} for your router's links, and navLabel and labels to translate the fixed words.
